Did you know that color TV existed decades before it became mainstream? In this video, we explore the incredible story behind how television evolved from blurry black-and-white to vibrant color broadcasts, and why it took nearly 50 years to make the switch. Watch to the end to learn about the innovations, challenges, and clever tricks that made it possible to transmit color without replacing millions of existing TVs.
